items.exampleEn: Some people eat seaweed with rice.
The snowstorm lasted for three days.
items.exampleZh: 那場暴風雪持續了三天。

items.exampleEn: From the mountaintop, we could see the whole valley.
items.exampleZh: 從山頂上，我們可以看到整個山谷。

items.exampleEn: You shouldn't drink seawater; it has too much salt.
items.exampleZh: 你不應該喝海水，因為它含有太多鹽分。

items.exampleEn: The baby giraffe was already taller than me.
items.exampleZh: 那隻小長頸鹿已經比我還高了。

items.exampleEn: A thunderous voice came from the speakers.
items.exampleZh: 喇叭傳出雷鳴般的聲音。

items.exampleEn: Frost covered the fields after the cold night.
items.exampleZh: 寒冷的一夜過後，田野上覆蓋了一層霜。

items.exampleEn: The weather forecast was wrong again.

items.sentenceEn: Did you check the weather forecast?

items.audioEn: The snowstorm stopped, so the children ran outside to play in the snow.
items.audioZh: 暴風雪停了，孩子們跑到外面玩雪。
items.questionZh: 暴風雪停了以後，孩子們做什麼？

items.sentenceEn: A small café sits on the mountaintop.
items.sentenceZh: 山頂上有一家小咖啡館。

items.stemEn: The ____ has a very long neck, so it can reach the highest leaves.
items.stemZh: 長頸鹿的脖子很長，所以能吃到最高的葉子。

items.stemEn: When the band came on stage, the fans gave a ____ cheer.
items.stemZh: 樂團一上台，粉絲們就發出震耳欲聾的歡呼。

items.passageEn: Last winter, my class took a trip to the mountains. The weather forecast said it would be sunny, so we set off early. When we reached the mountaintop, the view was amazing. But suddenly, the sky turned dark, and a snowstorm came. We heard a thunderous sound far away. We waited in a small cabin and shivered all night. The next morning, there was frost on every window. On the way home, we stopped at a town by the sea. The air smelled of seawater and seaweed. There was also a small animal park, where we fed a giraffe. It was a trip we will never forget.
items.passageZh: 去年冬天，我們班去山上旅行。天氣預報說會是晴天，所以我們一早就出發了。我們到達山頂時，景色美極了。但天空突然變暗，暴風雪來了。我們聽到遠處傳來雷鳴般的聲音。我們在一間小木屋裡等待，冷得整夜發抖。第二天早上，每扇窗戶上都結了霜。回家途中，我們在一個海邊小鎮停留。空氣中有海水和海藻的味道。那裡還有一座小型動物園，我們餵了一隻長頸鹿。那是一趟我們永遠不會忘記的旅行。

questions.questionZh: 他們到達山頂時發生了什麼事？
在海邊小鎮，他們做了什麼？

referenceEn: There was frost on the grass this morning.
This morning there was frost on the grass.
rubricZh: frost 表示「霜」，例如 frost on the grass 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）

items.promptZh: 我每天早上出門前都會看天氣預報。
referenceEn: I check the weather forecast every morning before I go out.
Every morning, I check the weather forecast before I leave home.
rubricZh: 用 weather forecast 表示「天氣預報」
「看」可寫，例如 check、look at 等
